description: This Java source file defines the ConnectionSupervisorActor class, which manages ConnectionPersistenceActor instances, handling their lifecycle, supervision strategy, and exception handling within an Akka actor system. It includes methods for creating actor properties, retrieving entity IDs, and configuring supervision behavior.

classes.name: ConnectionSupervisorActor
classes.description: An Akka actor that supervises ConnectionPersistenceActor instances, managing their lifecycle, restart policies, and exception handling strategies within a distributed system.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates Props for instantiating a ConnectionSupervisorActor with specified parameters.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Retrieves the ConnectionId entity ID based on the actor's self path name.

methods.name: getPersistenceActorProps
methods.description: Provides Props for creating the ConnectionPersistenceActor associated with a specific ConnectionId.

methods.name: getExponentialBackOffConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the exponential back-off configuration for supervisor restart delays from the system configuration.

methods.name: getShutdownBehaviour
methods.description: Defines the shutdown behavior for the supervisor based on the entity ID.

methods.name: getUnavailableExceptionBuilder
methods.description: Builds an exception indicating the connection is unavailable, for use when the actor cannot process requests.

methods.name: supervisorStrategy
methods.description: Returns the supervision strategy used by this actor, which resumes on JMSRuntimeException and stops on ActorKilledException.
